run_compare_models: run the script to compare model outputs between two data directories by reading log.txt files
run_get_args_parser: run the argument parser to configure data_path1, data_path2, output_dir, and seed parameters
run_get_caption: run the get_caption function to extract captions for a given image_id from annotations list
run_main: run the main function to iterate over folders and print the last line from each model's log.txt
summarize_compare_models: summarize the compare_models script that compares evaluation results between two model output directories
